## ✨ About me

Hi, I'm **Adelia**, a Business Information Systems student interested in **software engineering**, **UI/UX design**, and **ERP systems**. I like turning complex ideas into practical, friendly digital experiences.

- 🎓 Studying Business Information Systems
- 🔭 Working on PyLearn, an automated Python learning platform, and custom Odoo ERP modules
- 🌱 Learning Figma prototyping, enterprise architecture, and Firebase/API integration
- 💬 Ask me about Laravel, Flutter, UI/UX workflows, or database design
- 🤝 Open to collaborating on web, mobile, and UI/UX projects
- 🪢 Fun fact: I enjoy jump-rope workouts before a deep-work session
